svg.title: CassChat complete business flow - Group 4
svg.text: Business flow of one operation: from the command we type to the number in the report
Solid arrow = synchronous call that waits for an answer. Dashed arrow = asynchronous / runs in parallel. Diamonds = decisions that change the outcome.
Results on the host filesystem (bind mount /work/results)
do_write: random room, msg_id = uuid1(), payload, run_id
do_probe: write seq n via node A, read it back via node B
stmt(cql, cl): prepared statement cached per (cql, CL), CL fixed
routing key = room -> Murmur3 token -> the 3 replicas
TokenAwarePolicy picks a replica as coordinator (or pinned
request_timeout 5 s; CQL native protocol over TCP :9042
gossip view, before any replica is asked
then ack; hint stored for a DOWN replica
full data reads, newest cell wins (LWW),
success: RESULT frame (rows for a read, void for a write)
no: Unavailable error, nothing written (decided before any replica is contacted)
timeout: WriteTimeout / ReadTimeout. For a write this means UNKNOWN, not failed:
replicas that applied it keep it (no rollback)
no reply in 5 s: driver raises OperationTimedOut (client_timeout)
only rows in the measured window
exit code 0, or 3 if nothing succeeded
Tables and charts in the report and
deck come from step 15, so every
number traces back to CSV rows
write their own CSVs the same way
docker kill cass3 (async, while traffic runs)
